This is a style rule that makes every comment start the same way. By default, a comment that starts with a lowercase letter is reported.

Comments that start with something other than a letter, comments that start with a URL, and comments for tools such as `eslint-disable`, `global` or `istanbul ignore` are never reported.

`--fix` changes the case of the first letter.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"capitalized-comments" = "error" # or "warn"
```

Every option, set to its default. The ones that are commented out are unset by default.

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"capitalized-comments" = [
  "error",
  "always", # "always" or "never"
  {
    # ignorePattern = <string>,
    ignoreInlineComments = false,
    ignoreConsecutiveComments = false,
    # line = <object>,
    # block = <object>,
  },
]
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```js
// retry once, then give up
await send(message);
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```js
// Retry once, then give up
await send(message);

// 3 attempts at most
// https://example.com/retries explains why
/* eslint-disable-next-line no-console */
console.log("sent");
```

## Options

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
capitalized-comments = ["error", "always", { ignoreConsecutiveComments = true }]
```

The first option is `"always"` (default), which requires a capital letter, or `"never"`, which requires a lowercase letter.

{/* bad {"options": ["never"]} */}
```js
// Retry once, then give up
await send(message);
```

The second option is an object:

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ignorePattern` | none | A regular expression. A comment that starts with a match isn't checked. |
| `ignoreInlineComments` | `false` | Don't check a comment that has code before and after it on the same line. |
| `ignoreConsecutiveComments` | `false` | Don't check a comment that comes right after another comment, so only the first line of a group counts. |

{/* good {"options": ["always", {"ignorePattern": "webpack"}]} */}
```js
const editor = import(/* webpackChunkName: "editor" */ "./editor.js");
```

{/* good {"options": ["always", {"ignoreInlineComments": true}]} */}
```js
function resize(width, /* optional */ height) {}
```

{/* good {"options": ["always", {"ignoreConsecutiveComments": true}]} */}
```js
// Retry once, then give up,
// so that a slow server does not block the queue
await send(message);
```

To use different settings for `//` and `/* */` comments, put the same options under `line` and `block`. Here only the `//` comment is reported:

{/* bad {"options": ["always", {"block": {"ignorePattern": "webpack"}}], "count": 1} */}
```js
// webpack splits the bundle here
const editor = import(/* webpackChunkName: "editor" */ "./editor.js");
```
